findings.impact: A modified or stale facts file can authorize an unsupported prior-employment Yes while the checker reports PASS_STRUCTURED_CHECK.
findings.reproduction: Mutate in-memory facts.employers by adding HCA while leaving source_sha256 unchanged; submit prior_employer Yes with source resume:employer:hca; check() returns [].
findings.required_fix: Fail closed unless the facts artifact itself is pinned/verified, and validate every employer/alias source reference against a canonical extracted fact set or signed/pinned baseline. Add a regression that mutates employers without changing résumé bytes.
findings.title: Employer facts are not cryptographically or semantically bound to the résumé

findings.impact: The executable gate can pass a packet without an exact destination or evidence-backed answer even though the workflow promises exact application review.
findings.reproduction: Use job_url='https://' and source='resume:anything' on a required other answer; check() returns [].
findings.required_fix: Parse the URL and require HTTPS hostname plus concrete job path/identifier. Define and validate structured source IDs for non-employer answers, or keep them unresolved until semantic review records a verified passage.
findings.title: Exact job URL and non-employer résumé citations are accepted without validation

authorization.evidence: Skill starts in prepare mode, distinguishes installation from authorization, preserves existing exact-scope approval, and requires exact employer/role/files/answers review. The checker explicitly outputs submission_authorized:false and does not validate approval records.

blanket_no_policy.evidence: PROMPT and SKILL restrict standing No to unlisted prior-employer questions and explicitly keep authorization, sponsorship, prior applications, military service, demographics, current employment, and worked-with relationships separate. Checker rejects a No for a known exact employer and rejects substring aliases, but cannot classify question semantics or time/affiliate qualifiers.

claim_limits.evidence: Tailoring cannot change history; dates/months, metrics, credentials, clearance, hiring probability, portal behavior, and live-test claims are explicitly constrained. Synthetic tests are not presented as portal evidence.

duplicate_submit_and_receipt.evidence: Skill requires employer+requisition/canonical-URL dedupe, prior receipt checks, submission_attempted before one final action, no blind retry, and submitted_confirmed only from a role-bound ATS/email receipt. CSV exposes corresponding fields. There is no atomic reservation or executable cross-session duplicate gate.

exact_destination_and_answer_source.evidence: Adversarial probe with job_url='https://' and a required current-employment answer sourced as resume:anything returned zero errors. startswith(https://) does not establish an exact ATS URL, and arbitrary resume: prefixes are not verified citations.

resume_employer_baseline.evidence: Pinned résumé hash matches. Employer headings for RIG, Oracle/formerly Cerner, EmOpti, Advocate/former Aurora, and United States Army are present. HCA, Foxconn, Ideawake, Noom, Babyscripts, and Startup Health occur in partnership/investment/accomplishment passages rather than employer headings, consistent with the relationship exclusions.

source_binding.evidence: Adversarial in-memory probe appended HCA as a fictitious employer to facts while retaining the real résumé digest. A Yes answer sourced as resume:employer:hca returned zero errors. The checker binds the résumé digest fields but does not bind or validate employer-fact content against the résumé or a pinned facts-file digest.

limitations: The 12 tests are synthetic and no actual ATS portal, upload, form, authenticated account, receipt, or submission was exercised.

Authorization and duplicate prevention are currently procedural agent instructions, not atomic executable gates. Concurrent sessions can still race unless the verified cockpit ledger supplies reservation semantics.
Natural-language question classification, temporal qualifiers, affiliate clauses, attestations, and free-text materials require separate human/independent claim review.
Different-model-family GEV separation was not established.
scope: Read-only package, baseline, checker, and synthetic test review. No provider, browser, application portal, submission, or source-code changes.
